Result screen: project-title, status-banner (Constructible, GEOMETRY_OK), all 8 KeyValue chiffres clés rendered correctly (Marches=16, Hauteur=175mm, Giron=280mm, Pente=33.69°, Blondel=630mm, Échappée=2275mm, Longueur volée=5047.77mm, Reculement=4200mm), section-tabs present with all 3 tabs (tab-section-long/trans/axial). Section SVG content changes per tab: long=13410 chars, trans=5181 chars, axial=6093 chars — 3 visually distinct SVGs confirmed by screenshots (long shows step profile, trans shows section transversale with rebars & 900mm width, axial shows béton armé indicative with HA principaux + chapeaux appui haut). NO crash / red screen when switching tabs. export-pdf-btn visible & clickable → fires POST /api/dossier/generate → 200 application/pdf → web blob download triggered → stairpilot_TEST_droit.pdf saved locally, 10725 bytes (>3KB required; includes concrete_analysis so >10KB expected).

react_native_issues.issue: Recurring warnings 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and '"shadow*" style props deprecated. Use boxShadow' — non-blocking (react-native-web version). Same as iter 7.

critical_code_review_comments: mobile/src/pdf.ts uses `await import('expo-file-system')` inside a web branch guard — clean. Uses new API `File`/`Paths` from expo-file-system v19+ (Paths.cache + File.create/write). Confirm the installed expo-file-system version exposes File/Paths (only relevant on native; web branch is fine).

backend/server.py: DossierRequest uses `dict` for stair_input/stair_result — permissive but loses Pydantic validation. Consider typing them as StairInput / StairResult once the mobile payload shape is stable, to reject malformed dossier requests with a proper 422 instead of silently generating a PDF with missing fields.

result.tsx handleExportPDF calls analyzeConcrete synchronously before generateAndSharePDF — adds ~1-2s latency and requires a working /api/concrete/analyze even when the user only wants the geometry dossier. Consider making concrete_analysis truly optional (fire-and-forget or user toggle) — currently a failure of concrete API is swallowed which is OK, but success path always waits.
pdf.ts: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is captured at module load; if the value is missing at build time the app will throw at click time only. A build-time guard would give faster feedback.
